main_text.head: ALIVD.
main_text.p:
ILLA dies terris quæ te tulit ante, Navarre,
Ut columen patriæ conspicerétve patrem,
Indignata tibi crudelia fata parare
Guisiadem, hunc subito frigore iusta ferit,
Vnius ardentes restinguens sanguine flammas,
Gallorumq; vna plurima bella nece.
Clara dies tanti regis natalibus, Euge
Clarior adscito funere Guisiadæ.
main_text.head: ALIVD.
main_text.p:
Quæ te (Rex) terris ostendit prima, Navarre
Signetur creta nobiliore dies
Nascentis nam fausta prius cunabula vitæ
Quum dedit, hoc dixit non satis esse tibi,
Ni te perpetuo comitetur amica fauore,
Atq; hostes cunctos perdat acerba tuos.
Hoc facit, unius lethæo flumine mersum
Guisiadis tandem quum rapit illa caput.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (mask within scrollwork) below the text, not transcribed. Verse lines are set as printed, with line breaks shown by br. Some letters in the scan are doubtful, notably "Vnius" and "Guisiadem", which may be misprinted.
